style_block: Inked cel-painted 2D combat-racing game art. Crisp near-black (#171B20) contours, chunky readable mechanical shapes, restrained paint chips, matte two-tone material shading. Rubber is charcoal (#252930), glass is blue-black (#273C48), bare metal is cool grey (#89949B), highlights are warm ivory (#E8DFC8); the assigned subject accent belongs only to painted panels. Neutral even diffuse illumination, symmetric highlights, no directional cast shadow. Clean graphic silhouette, consistent bold contour and sparse interior strokes; no photorealism, no 3D render finish.
camera: True orthographic top-down: camera directly above, roof planes only, no visible front or side body faces. Cars point right, toward screen +x.
negative: No driver, no people inside vehicles, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no perspective, no cast shadows, no cropped subject, no decorative ground.
